backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the healthcare backend, defining data types (UserProfile, Credentials, MLPrediction, etc.) and exposing query/update methods for user profiles, credential management, and ML predictions with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to their titles, associated source files, component dependencies, and test IDs for tracking implementation of medical assistant knowledge base and routing features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing the purpose of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase structure.
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Documents deployment fixes applied to resolve frontend build failures, including replacing Node.js `process.env` with Vite `import.meta.env` and removing duplicate provider wrappers in `main.tsx`.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title and mounting the React root via `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes and composes the full provider tree (ThemeProvider, DesignBProvider, QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider).
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: localStorage-based demo credential store that handles account creation with phone number uniqueness enforcement, password hashing, and credential verification for the demo authentication flow.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for demo authentication: DemoAccount structure, and result types for verifying and creating accounts.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Manages local session persistence in localStorage for OTP, password, and guest auth flows, including save, load, clear, and expiry validation utilities.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Core logic for the AI assistant that detects emergencies, greetings, navigation intents, and medical topics, then routes queries to the appropriate knowledge base to produce a response.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Renders the chat panel for the AI assistant, showing the message transcript, a typing indicator, suggested prompt chips, and a welcome state with capability badges when empty.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Handles localStorage persistence for the healthcare assistant transcript, including save, load, and clear operations with migration support from v1 and v2 formats to v3.
Defines TypeScript types and interfaces for the assistant, including message roles, confidence levels, assistant status, report analysis context, command results, and specialty filters.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: A floating assistant widget with a sheet UI that handles user text/voice input, dispatches messages to the assistant brain, and supports specialty filtering and navigation actions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/custom: Empty file, likely a placeholder for custom Q&A pair storage logic.
Empty file, likely a placeholder for custom Q&A type definitions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/fuzzyQ: Empty file, likely a placeholder for fuzzy matching logic against custom Q&A entries.
frontend/src/components/assistant/genera: Provides a static knowledge base of general health topics (e.g., immune system, vaccines, inflammation) with keyword arrays and detailed markdown responses for client-side lookup.
frontend/src/components/assistant/langua: Implements client-side language detection using character range analysis and word/pattern matching to identify 23 supported languages without external APIs.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Contains a large static array of medical topics (cardiology, dermatology, etc.) with associated keywords and detailed markdown responses covering diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Messag: Parses and renders markdown-like assistant message content into React elements, supporting headings, lists, tables, blockquotes, bold, and inline code.
frontend/src/components/assistant/messag: Provides deterministic summarization of long assistant messages into concise bullet points, preserving medical terminology, emergency indicators, and action items.
frontend/src/components/assistant/multil: Defines multilingual response templates for 8 supported languages (en, es, fr, de, zh, ar, hi, pt), covering greetings, help text, emergency prefixes, and error messages for the AI assistant.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Provides deterministic, pattern-based analysis of medical report text, extracting key findings, generating interpretations for common lab values, suggesting actions, and identifying red flags without using AI/LLM.
Extracts text from uploaded report files by detecting text-based formats via extension/content-type and decoding bytes as UTF-8, rejecting binary or invalid content.
frontend/src/components/assistant/respon: Formats AI assistant responses with empathetic openings, specialty attribution headers, and medical disclaimers, supporting informational, urgent, reassuring, and general tones.
frontend/src/components/assistant/specia: Contains a structured knowledge base of medical specialties (e.g., cardiology, dermatology) with keywords, conditions, symptoms, diagnostic tools, treatments, red flags, and formatted content strings.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Sugges: A styled button chip component that displays a suggested prompt with an optional emoji icon and triggers a callback when clicked.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Typing: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with the assistant avatar to signal that the assistant is processing a response.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook that manages the assistant conversation transcript, handling persistent storage load/save, adding messages with metadata, toggling message expansion, and clearing history.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: Custom React hook that wraps the Web Speech Recognition API, handling start/stop listening, interim/final transcripts, confidence levels, and automatic retry logic on errors.
Custom React hook that wraps the Web Speech Synthesis API, providing speak, cancel, and toggle-enabled functionality with speaking state tracking.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: Custom React hook that manages auto-scrolling of a transcript container, tracking whether the user is near the bottom and only auto-scrolling when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/CloseButton.tsx: A fixed-position close button component that navigates to '/home' by default or calls an optional onClick handler.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: Presentational component rendering a section header with a title, optional caption, and optional action element aligned to the right.
Versatile dashboard tile component displaying an icon, label, value, and caption with configurable color accents, sizes, and interactive states including an optional close button.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: Simple wrapper component that applies card surface styling in default, elevated (with shadow), or outlined (with border) variants.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Collection of typed typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, BodyText) with consistent Tailwind-based styling.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: Toggle switch component that switches between the default and Design B themes using the DesignB theme context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Exports a mock user profile generated with a fixed seed for consistent demo data across the Design B UI.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: Top-level layout shell for Design B that renders a sticky header with branding and user info, bottom navigation, the voice assistant widget, page outlet, and a footer.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: Fixed bottom navigation bar with Home, Reports, and Profile tabs that highlights the active route.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: Utility functions to persist and retrieve the selected design theme ('default' or 'designB') from localStorage.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines the Design B theme constants (palette, fonts, spacing, radius) and provides helper functions to apply or remove the theme via a data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: React context provider that manages the active design theme state, persists it to localStorage, and applies it as a data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: Provides callbacks to save and clear local authentication sessions for OTP, password, and guest sign-in types using the session utility module.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendCredentials: Exposes React Query hooks for checking, adding, and verifying user credentials against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: Manages a client-side demo OTP session with 6-digit code generation, expiry validation, and a resend cooldown timer.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, handling AuthClient creation, login, identity persistence, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: Manages medical file operations (list, upload, delete, download, get bytes) against the ICP backend using React Query mutations and queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for backend data fetching, including a placeholder example query and a hook to fetch the current caller's user profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Redirects already-authenticated users (via Internet Identity or local session) away from public pages to /home.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin, checking both Internet Identity and local session state.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Resolves a display name for the current user by checking profile name, local session data, Internet Identity principal, and falling back to 'Guest'.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes plus a 'designB' theme variant.
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using a seeded PRNG (mulberry32) to produce realistic user profile data including names, emails, phone numbers, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module exporting a `cn` helper that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentDetails.ts: Empty file with no content; placeholder for an appointment details page.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Full-featured chat page component with message history, speech recognition, specialty filtering, suggested prompts, and an AI assistant brain integration.
frontend/src/pages/Chatbot.tsx: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a chatbot page.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorList.tsx: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a doctor list page.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Health dashboard home page displaying today's metrics (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories) and quick-action tiles for navigating to health tools like the chatbot.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a home dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/Locate.tsx: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a location/map page.
frontend/src/pages/Medications.tsx: Medications page that displays a daily medication schedule with taken/untaken status and reminder times, using static mock data.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: Redirect component that automatically navigates users from unknown or removed routes to the /home page on mount.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Profile page that displays and allows editing of personal/medical information (name, blood type, allergies, emergency contact) with validation, and provides a sign-out action.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical Reports page that lets authenticated users upload, view, and delete medical documents, with file size formatting and upload status feedback.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page supporting three authentication methods: OTP via phone, password-based login, and Internet Identity, with step-based OTP flow and session initialization.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Sign-up page that collects full name, phone number, and password to create a new account, stores credentials in the backend, and initializes a local profile session.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing/welcome page with hero image and branding that routes unauthenticated users to sign-in or allows them to continue as a guest.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Utility module providing bidirectional mapping functions between the backend UserProfile type and the frontend ProfileDetails type, including blood type enum conversion and bigint/date string conversion.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: Provides localStorage-backed CRUD functions for profile data, keyed by phone number or a stable guest ID depending on the current session type. Also includes a merge utility to initialize profile fields from auth data without overwriting existing values.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines the `ProfileDetails` TypeScript interface for editable user health profile fields, along with helper functions to create an empty profile and check whether a profile contains any data.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Validates a `ProfileDetails` object and returns a list of human-readable error messages covering required fields, email format, phone length/format, and emergency contact completeness.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React Query hook that loads and saves user profile details, routing to the ICP backend for Internet Identity sessions and to localStorage for local (password/OTP/guest) sessions.
Provides localStorage-backed CRUD helpers for `MedicalFileMetadata` objects keyed by file ID; noted as deprecated for listing purposes in favor of the backend metadata API.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Reads the Internet Identity provider URL from the `VITE_II_URL` environment variable and exposes it via `getInternetIdentityUrl` and `getFrontendConfig` helpers, defaulting to the production II URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that enables dark mode, registers typography/container-queries/animate plugins, and extends the theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project state for a 10-specialty medical health assistant app, including feature list, architectural notes, image requirements, and versioning metadata. Tracks existing features covering knowledge base expansion, routing logic, UI components, and response formatting across all medical specialties.
